mission_07: You have implemented causal forests, a powerful machine learning approach for estimating heterogeneous treatment effects. By modifying the splitting criterion to maximize treatment effect differences rather than prediction accuracy, causal forests identify subgroups that respond differently to treatment. Honest estimation — using separate data for tree construction and effect estimation — provides valid statistical inference. The variable importance scores reveal which features drive heterogeneity, enabling targeted interventions. Causal forests are used in precision medicine (identifying who benefits most from treatment), marketing (finding responsive customers), and policy design (targeting interventions to those most affected). For production use, consider the grf (Generalized Random Forests) R package or the causalml Python library.
